title: Gokul’s Data Signal 15 — Cross-industry layoffs
scope: Ten selected companies across four editorial groups. Selected 2026 disclosures and workforce comparisons, not a census or sector ranking. Technology includes FAANG + NVIDIA. Dates and periods vary.

rows.note: One selected round, not a 2026 total. Corporate-role reduction; do not divide by Amazon’s all-employee workforce or assume all affected people left.
